assumptions: Two-arm Tm falls in the window given; the backbone is the one supplied.
limits: Without BLAST results it returns the targets to search and says the junction check did not run.
Packs non-overlapping targets from the 3' end; it does not rank by detection efficiency.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which padlock probes target this transcript for in-situ sequencing, and which junctions could be ligated on another transcript?

description: Design padlock probes for in-situ sequencing against the subject: find the two-arm targets whose melting temperature falls in a window, check each against a BLAST search for any other transcript that could be ligated across the junction, pack non-overlapping targets from the 3' end, and assemble each into its padlock with the backbone given. Without BLAST results it returns the targets to search, and says the junction check has not been run.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

arm_length.description: length of each target arm; the target is twice this. In nt.

barcode.description: the barcode read out by sequencing. Advanced.

blast_csv.description: blastn -outfmt 10 output for the targets FASTA this tool returns (run with -word_size 7 -strand plus against your transcriptome). Without it no target is checked for junction specificity.

interval.description: fewest bases between two packed targets. In nt.

linker_downstream.description: backbone sequence between the barcode and the 5' arm. Advanced.

linker_upstream.description: backbone sequence between the 3' arm and the barcode. Advanced.

max_tm.description: highest target melting temperature to accept (exclusive). In °C.

min_tm.description: lowest target melting temperature to accept (exclusive), at 0.1 µM probe, 75 mM monovalent, 10 mM divalent salt and 20% formamide. In °C.

variants.description: comma-separated accessions (no version) that count as the target itself, such as its isoforms. Empty: a hit counts as the target only when its accession is in the subject's name. Only applies when blast_csv is set. Advanced.

name: design_padlock_probes

explanation.description: the derivation chain: conclusion, interpretation and machinery, generated from this run

packed.description: every packed target before the database-mappability filter. Null until `blast_csv` is given

padlockCount.description: how many padlock probes survived. Null until `blast_csv` is given, because a 0 would read as none surviving a check that has not been run

padlocks.description: the final padlock probes (target found in the database), each with its start, target, full sequence and Tm. Null until `blast_csv` is given: the junction check has not been run

targetsFasta.description: the melting-temperature-passing targets as FASTA, named target_N, for blastn
